sloka: दूरमाभ्यामनुगतो लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना ।भरतेन च शत्रुघ्नो जगामाशु पुरं ततः ।। ७.७२.२१ ।।
transliteration: dūramābhyāmanugato lakṣmaṇena mahātmanā ।bharatena ca śatrughno jagāmāśu puraṁ tataḥ ।। 7.72.21 ।।

translations.english: After being accompanied for a long distance by the great-souled Lakshmana and Bharata, Shatrughna then quickly proceeded to the city of Ayodhya. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे द्विसप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 72 ।। Thus ends the seventy-second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
